description: Add a student to the free Prepalyst talent pool, which puts candidates forward to finance employers (employers pay Prepalyst; students never do). Do the work for the student: read the resume they shared, fill in every field you can from it, and ask only for what is missing (often work authorization and start term). Show them the three lines from get_talent_pool_terms and call this only after they clearly say yes. It returns a link: the student opens it, signs in (Google works) and taps one button to confirm. Nothing is saved to the pool or shared before that tap, and the link expires in 7 days.

available_from.description: When they can start: "Spring 2027", "Summer 2027", "Fall 2027" (any year) or "Later".

gpa.description: GPA if the resume or student gives it, e.g. "3.65".

note.description: Anything else employers should know, in the student's words.

resume_text.description: The full text of the resume, as written.

target_roles.description: Up to four kinds of role they want.

items.description: INVESTMENT_BANKING = Investment Banking; PRIVATE_EQUITY = Private Equity; HEDGE_FUND = Hedge Funds; VENTURE_CAPITAL = Venture Capital; ASSET_MANAGEMENT = Asset Management; EQUITY_RESEARCH = Equity Research; SALES_AND_TRADING = Sales & Trading; PRIVATE_CREDIT = Private Credit; REAL_ESTATE_PE = Real Estate PE; CORPORATE_DEVELOPMENT = Corporate Development; CORPORATE_FINANCE = Corporate Finance; QUANT_FINANCE = Quant Finance

terms_accepted.description: True only after the student saw the terms and said yes.

work_authorization.description: Work in the United States: AUTHORIZED without sponsorship, or NEEDS_SPONSORSHIP. Ask if unsure.

name: submit_resume
title: Add a student to the talent pool
